title: Banks Act Circular C4/2013 — Treatment of investments in banking, financial, securities, insurance and commercial entities
enablingLegislation: Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Treatment of investments in banking, financial, securities, insurance and commercial entities.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This circular applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Treatment of investments in banking, financial, securities, insurance and commercial entities.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Treatment of investments in banking, financial, securities, insurance and commercial entities. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
